info.title: FlyHub Virtual Airlines API
info.description: The supported Virtual Airlines integration contract. The public resources are read-only and scoped to the airline that issued the fhva_live bearer key. The management operations document the Ownership controls used by FlyHub and require a FlyHub session. The webhook entries describe the Discord-compatible request FlyHub sends to a configured Discord destination; they are not arbitrary customer-hosted callback endpoints.

tags.name: public-api
tags.description: Read-only resources for airline websites, dashboards, and private integrations.

tags.name: api-keys
tags.description: Ownership controls for creating and revoking public API keys.

tags.name: discord-webhooks
tags.description: Ownership controls and event payloads for Discord notifications.

get.description: Returns the profile attached to the bearer key. The airline is derived from the key; no airline ID can be supplied by the caller. This resource is not paginated.
Returns active airline memberships with pilot statistics. Suspended, rejected, left, and removed memberships are excluded. Results are ordered by joinedAt from oldest to newest.
Returns airline logbook activity, newest first. Inspect each status: a row records airline flight activity and is not automatically a successful completion.
Returns non-retired aircraft associated with the airline, ordered by registration. This is a public snapshot and does not expose fleet-management actions.
Returns schedules with active or suspended status, ordered by flight number. Operating-day masks are Monday-first and all date checks in Virtual Airlines use UTC.
Returns one aggregate object. It is not paginated and consumes 25 row-budget units, so use it for summary cards rather than as a substitute for the detail resources.
Returns the Ownership view of API-key and Discord-destination metadata. Requires a normal FlyHub session and the manage_ownership capability. Secrets and raw Discord URLs are never returned.
Lists key metadata and the available read scopes. The raw secret is never returned. Requires manage_ownership and is limited to 50 records.

post.description: Creates a read-only key. The complete secret appears only in this 201 response; save it on a server before closing the response. Requires manage_ownership. The airline can have at most 10 active keys.

delete.description: Soft-revokes an active key immediately and preserves its historical metadata. There is no restore endpoint; rotate by creating a replacement first, then revoking the old key.

get.description: Lists Discord destination metadata and the complete allowed event catalog. Raw webhook URLs are never returned. Requires manage_ownership and is limited to 25 records.

post.description: Creates an encrypted Discord destination for selected airline events. Only exact HTTPS Discord webhook hosts and paths are accepted. Requires manage_ownership; an airline can have at most 10 active or paused destinations.

patch.description: Renames a destination, replaces its event subscription list, or changes its status between active and paused. The Discord URL cannot be edited in place, and a disabled destination cannot be reactivated.

delete.description: Soft-removes the destination, stops future deliveries, and preserves historical metadata. Removal cannot be undone through the API; create a replacement if needed.

post.description: Posts a direct test message that says FlyHub webhook connected. It does not create a flight event or queue an outbox delivery. Requires manage_ownership.
FlyHub sends this Discord embed when a flight booking is recorded. The embed may include status, flight number, route, aircraft, pilot, tracking mode, and load when available.
FlyHub sends this Discord embed when a flight instance is cancelled. The embed may include state, reason, flight number, route, aircraft, and planned times.
FlyHub sends this Discord embed when a flight result is accepted. The embed may include route, aircraft, pilot, tracking, load, distance, block time, landing rate, score, and settlement context.
FlyHub sends this Discord embed when a flight result is rejected. The embed may include classification, rejection reason, route, aircraft, pilot, performance, and score.
FlyHub sends this Discord embed when a pilot application is received and remains pending.
FlyHub sends this Discord embed when a pilot becomes active in the airline.
FlyHub sends this Discord embed when a pilot application or membership is rejected.
FlyHub sends this Discord embed when an active pilot is suspended.
FlyHub sends this Discord embed when a suspended pilot becomes active again.
FlyHub sends this Discord embed when a pilot leaves the airline.
FlyHub sends this Discord embed when a manager removes a pilot.
FlyHub sends this Discord embed when a pilot's airline role changes.
FlyHub sends this Discord embed when an aircraft or its operating state changes. The embed may include registration, type, station, status, condition, maintenance state, hours, and cycles.
FlyHub sends this Discord embed when a published route or schedule changes. The embed may include flight number, route, operation type, days, block time, eligible aircraft, and status.
FlyHub sends this Discord embed when a flight settlement is recorded. It can include flight context, net result, and currency; it is not a complete accounting export.
FlyHub sends this Discord embed when airline content is published. The embed includes the public content kind, version, and publication status when available.

vaApiKey.description: A read-only FlyHub VA API key created from Ownership. Keep it on your integration server.

flyHubSession.description: A normal signed-in FlyHub session for the current owner or user with manage_ownership. Never expose it in a third-party website.

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: Requested page size. The API uses 25 by default, accepts 1–100, and caps larger values at 100. Invalid values fall back to the default.

Offset.name: offset
Offset.description: Number of records to skip. The API uses 0 by default and caps values at 10000.

AirlineId.name: airlineId
AirlineId.description: UUID of the airline management context. This is used only by signed-in Ownership routes.

KeyId.name: keyId
KeyId.description: UUID of the API key metadata record.

WebhookId.name: webhookId
WebhookId.description: UUID of the Discord destination metadata record.

RateLimitLimit.description: Requests allowed in the current public API window.

RateLimitRemaining.description: Requests remaining in the current public API window.

RateLimitReset.description: ISO timestamp when the public API request window resets.

RowReset.description: ISO timestamp when the hourly row budget resets.

RetryAfter.description: Seconds to wait before retrying after a rate limit.

operatingDaysMask.description: Monday=1, Tuesday=2, Wednesday=4, Thursday=8, Friday=16, Saturday=32, Sunday=64.

url.description: Must be an exact HTTPS Discord webhook URL; see the human guide for the accepted hosts and path pattern.

username.description: Airline ICAO code followed by Operations.

ApiKeyListResponse.description: API key metadata and available scopes.

CreateApiKeyResponse.description: New API key metadata and the one-time secret.

WebhookListResponse.description: Discord destination metadata and available event types.

WebhookMutationResponse.description: Discord destination metadata after creation or update.

Unauthorized.description: A valid FlyHub VA API key is required.

Forbidden.description: The key does not include the required read scope.

RateLimited.description: The request or hourly row budget was exceeded.

ServiceUnavailable.description: FlyHub cannot safely serve the request at the moment.

ManagerUnauthorized.description: A valid FlyHub session is required.

ManagerForbidden.description: The session lacks manage_ownership for this airline.

ManagerNotFound.description: The integration record was not found or is not active.

ManagerRateLimited.description: The Ownership management rate limit was exceeded.

ManagerUnavailable.description: The integration management operation is unavailable.

Conflict.description: The airline has reached the active API-key limit.

DiscordUnavailable.description: Discord did not accept the test post.
